name: Butylated hydroxyanisole
aliases: E320, BHA, butylated hydroxyanisole, hidroxianisol butilado, tert-butyl-4-hydroxyanisole, butylhydroxyanisole
what_is: A synthetic antioxidant used to prevent fats and oils in foods from spoiling.
why_botia: It flags it because it is classified as a possible endocrine disruptor with anti-androgenic and weak estrogenic effects, under surveillance for carcinogenicity.
can_1: Identify E320 or BHA in ingredient lists.
can_2: Trigger alerts on endocrine disruption and potential carcinogenicity under the Women's Health layer.
cannot_1: Confirm if the BHA was combined with other antioxidants to produce a synergistic 'cocktail effect'.
cannot_2: Determine the shelf-life extension achieved by the specific dose of BHA used.

sources.label: WHO State of the Science of Endocrine Disrupting Chemicals (2012)
